facts.fact: The Manitoba Chambers of Commerce campaign aimed to encourage local support of the province's 10,000 businesses, according to 6P Marketing's own case study.
facts.quote: encourage local support of the province’s 10,000 businesses in the fall leading up to a critical holiday season

facts.fact: According to 6P Marketing's case study, #BuyLocalMB ads started running in late summer 2021.
facts.quote: Starting in late summer 2021, #BuyLocalMB ads made their way onto billboards, TV, newspapers, and online

facts.fact: The #BuyLocalMB campaign entered eligible social media posts for a chance to win a $100 Visa gift card given out every week, per the case study.
facts.quote: Eligible posts would be entered for the chance to win a $100 Visa gift card given out every week throughout the campaign.

facts.fact: The campaign's creative was switched twice midway, for the shifts into fall and winter, according to the case study.
facts.quote: with creative switching up twice midway for the shifts into fall and winter

facts.fact: Campaign-branded tote bags were sent to all 67 Manitoba Chambers for distribution, according to the case study.
facts.quote: Campaign-branded tote bags went out to all 67 Manitoba Chambers for distribution around their communities

facts.fact: The chamber network had access to over 80 unique downloadable files in a resource portal, per the case study.
facts.quote: access over 80 unique downloadable files to print and use locally.

facts.fact: According to 6P Marketing, #BuyLocalMB ads were seen 37 million times in total.
According to 6P Marketing, #BuyLocalMB ads were seen 5.6 million times on Google Ads.
facts.quote: including 5.6 million times on Google Ads

facts.fact: According to 6P Marketing, #BuyLocalMB ads were seen 3.7 million times on Facebook.
According to 6P Marketing, #BuyLocalMB ads were seen 1.4 million times on Instagram.
According to 6P Marketing, #BuyLocalMB ads were seen 1.1 million times on YouTube.
Campaign-related social media posts received 32,600 engagements (likes, comments, reactions, and shares), per 6P Marketing.
facts.quote: Campaign-related social media posts saw 32,600 engagements (likes, comments, reactions, and shares).

facts.fact: The campaign's media event received coverage in eight outlets, according to 6P Marketing.
facts.quote: Our media event received coverage in eight outlets

facts.fact: The campaign landing page received 12,600 visits through online channels, according to 6P Marketing.
facts.quote: the campaign landing page received 12,600 visits through online channels
